fusions.name: The Dunking Stool
fusions.desc: Dunks the target under: it deals 13 damage, stuns it for 1 second, and leaves it [Soaked] for 8 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Spreading Wake
fusions.desc: A wake spreads from you and deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Damped] for 4 seconds. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Beading Runoff
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back onto whoever inflicted it.

fusions.name: Paddling Underneath

riders.text: your health recovers faster while you are on it
and you move faster on it
and your dodge chance rises on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on it, from bronze rank your health recovers 20% faster, from silver you move 12% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
